description.zh: 讀入三個整數，輸出有幾對數字相等（0、1 或 3）。
description.en: Given three integers, determine how many of them are equal to each other. The program must print one of these numbers: 3 (if all are the same), 2 (if two of them are equal to each other and the third is different) or 0 (if all numbers are different).

hint.en: Count how many pairs are equal.
